summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for MaxPlay covering: (1) Multi-Quality Per-Server Admin Panel (1080p/720p/480p/360p with X remove buttons for Server 1 & Server 2) + Smart Network Auto-Quality Selection + Hybrid Player Quality Drawer + Seamless Timestamp/Audio Sync on Quality Switch; (2) Download Engine Reliability (in-flight request deduplication + 3x silent retry on cold start), Locked Total MB Size, Per-Episode Exact MB Probing, Select-All Filter Locking, and 8-Worker Turbo Download Speed; (3) Provider Name Hiding (Server 1 & Server 2 only); (4) External Language Selector Live Sync with Extracted HLS Audio Tracks; (5) Online Player Native Hardware Volume & Brightness; (6) Back-Navigation Exact Scroll Position Restoration; (7) Kotlin Native Persistent Disk Image Cache (250MB LRU); and (8) 4GB RAM Phone Performance Optimization & APK Enhancements.
